metadata.description: Maps student issue types to the correct office, escalation level, and suggested bot behavior.

escalation_levels.auto: Bot can answer directly with sources.
escalation_levels.soft: Bot provides info but strongly recommends contacting the office.
escalation_levels.hard: Bot MUST NOT give a final answer. Must escalate to listed office immediately.

routes.label: General degree requirements (breadth, credits, GPA)
routes.bot_answer_note: Provide handbook-sourced answer. Always add: 'For official confirmation, contact csgradmn@umn.edu.'

routes.label: Whether student is on track to graduate
routes.bot_answer_note: Provide preliminary checklist only. State clearly: 'Official graduation eligibility must be confirmed with your CS graduate coordinator at csgradmn@umn.edu and through your GPAS audit.'

routes.label: Whether student meets prerequisites for a course
routes.bot_answer_note: Answer directly using prerequisite tool. Note if prerequisites require department consent.

routes.label: Whether a specific course counts toward a specific requirement
routes.bot_answer_note: Answer if course is in official approved list. If unclear, state uncertainty and refer to cs_grad. Always note if department approval is required.

routes.label: Breadth area categories and which courses count
routes.bot_answer_note: Answer from handbook. Add caveat that substitutions require coordinator approval.

routes.label: Whether transfer credits can count toward degree
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain general policy (transfer credit typically not allowed per CS handbook). For any exceptions or external coursework, route to cs_grad. Do not confirm applicability.

routes.label: Filing a petition or requesting a policy exception
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain the general petition process from handbook. Route all approvals to cs_grad/dgs. Offer email draft.

routes.label: Registration hold preventing enrollment
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain how to check holds in MyU. Route resolution to OneStop (612-624-1111 or onestop.umn.edu).

routes.label: Add/drop or late withdrawal deadlines
routes.bot_answer_note: Direct student to onestop.umn.edu/calendar for current term dates. Bot can provide general policy but not specific current-term dates unless deadline table is loaded.

routes.label: Changing a course from A-F to S/N grade basis
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain the S/N basis policy and the deadline to change (typically end of second week). Route the change request to OneStop or MyU.

routes.label: CPT (Curricular Practical Training) authorization
routes.bot_answer_note: ALWAYS escalate to ISSS. Bot may explain what CPT is in general terms but MUST NOT confirm eligibility, timing, or process details beyond 'contact ISSS at isss@umn.edu or 612-626-7100.'

routes.label: OPT (Optional Practical Training) application
routes.bot_answer_note: ALWAYS escalate to ISSS. Same rule as CPT — no final determination from bot.

routes.label: STEM OPT 24-month extension
routes.bot_answer_note: ALWAYS escalate to ISSS.

routes.label: Taking fewer than full-time credits as international student
routes.bot_answer_note: ALWAYS escalate to ISSS. Reduced course load for international students requires explicit ISSS authorization. Do not speculate on eligibility.

routes.label: Full-time enrollment requirement for international students
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain general rule (typically 6 credits for grad students) but route ALL specific questions to ISSS.

routes.label: General visa or immigration status questions
routes.bot_answer_note: Refer all visa/immigration questions to ISSS. Bot is not a legal or immigration resource.

routes.label: Requesting an official or unofficial transcript
routes.bot_answer_note: Direct to onestop.umn.edu/transcripts or MyU Self-Service. No escalation needed.

routes.label: Verifying enrollment status (for employer, insurance, etc.)
routes.bot_answer_note: Direct to OneStop or National Student Clearinghouse (online self-service).

routes.label: GPAS (Graduate Planning and Audit System) questions
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain GPAS is accessible via MyU > Academics > GPAS. For interpretation of GPAS output, route to cs_grad.

routes.label: Thesis or dissertation submission
routes.bot_answer_note: Answer from graduate school guidelines. Route formal submission questions to grad_school.

routes.label: Scheduling doctoral oral (preliminary or final) exam
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain process from handbook/grad school. Route scheduling to grad school and cs_grad.

routes.label: Leave of absence
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain general process. Remind international students they MUST contact ISSS before taking a leave.

routes.label: Withdrawing from the university
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain process and financial implications. Remind international students to contact ISSS.

routes.label: Financial aid, loans, grants questions
routes.bot_answer_note: Out of core scope. Direct to OneStop financial aid pages. Do not interpret financial aid decisions.

routes.label: Tuition, billing, or payment questions
routes.bot_answer_note: Direct to onestop.umn.edu/finances. Out of core scope.

routes.label: Academic probation or dismissal
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain general policy only. Route ALL specific standing questions to cs_grad and cse_grad. Offer email draft.

routes.label: Advisor is not responding
routes.bot_answer_note: Suggest following up politely after 1–2 weeks, then escalating to cs_grad or DGS. Offer email draft.

routes.label: Mental health crisis or distress
routes.bot_answer_note: IMMEDIATELY provide: Boynton Crisis Line 612-301-4673. Campus Police 911. Do not continue advising. Do not offer to draft emails.

routes.label: Housing questions
routes.bot_answer_note: Out of scope. Direct to housing.umn.edu.

routes.label: CS colloquium requirement enrollment and completion
routes.bot_answer_note: Answer from handbook. Explain colloquium is CSCI 8970 and the registration process.

routes.label: Filing the degree program form (Plan of Study)
routes.bot_answer_note: Explain the process and deadline from handbook. Route submission/approval to cs_grad.

routes.label: RA/TA funding questions
routes.bot_answer_note: Funding decisions are advisor/department-specific. Bot cannot advise on funding. Route to faculty advisor and cs_grad.
